business_summary: MRT Inc. operates a medical information platform. It provides Gaikin, a recruitment service specializing in part-time physicians; career, a job change support service for doctors; re:ray, a one stop outsourcing service; Door., an app to connect network of doctors; Door.into, an app platform that connects doctors and medical institutions with individuals; Pocket Doctor, a telemedicine app; groupware for medical departments; and FASTCALL a safety confirmation service for medical institutions consolidating the functions for hospital crisis management systems. The company also offers stem cell culture supernatant for medical institutions; pharmacist, clinical engineering technician, radiologic technologists, dialysis nurses, new practice openings and succession cases, clinical laboratory technician, and nurse recruitment services; job posting service for full-time and part-time industrial physicians; occupational health services; employment placement services; life support services; and full-time, part-time, and temporary positions for healthcare and welfare professionals. In addition, it engages in book publishing on illness and treatment; medical worker job placement business; business start-up; business succession support business; PR services, comprehensive membership compensation system, tax accountant referral services, and human umbilical cord-derived culture supernatant. Further, it offers anew, a service aimed at payroll calculation for doctors part-time jobs and payroll transfer agency services; Medikiki, an information distribution platform connecting manufacturers and wholesalers; and Kids Line that provides babysitting services. MRT Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
